resources.string: Upload using FTP, FTPS, or HTTP. Use File transfer for SMB, SFTP, and WebDAV. Configure and test the connection before uploading. Credentials stay on this page and are not saved, restored, or logged.
The HTTP adapter uses HTTPS only in this app. Do not embed credentials in the URL. Username and password may be empty.
For FTP/FTPS, enter a hostname, port, and credentials. FTPS uses explicit TLS with certificate verification; FTP is unencrypted.
Enter a valid hostname and port (1–65535).
Enter an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials, a query, or a fragment. An explicit URL port must match the port field.
FTP/FTPS requires a hostname, username, and password. Do not include a scheme or directory in the hostname.
Test this connection successfully first. Changes to the configuration require another test.
Connection test passed. Choose a file and confirm the upload.
Upload the selected file to the configured server?
Upload or connection did not complete (code: %1$s). Check the certificate, permissions, address, and network, then try again.
